course_name_original: Finite Element Method - Metode numerice II
course_name_en: Finite Element Method - Numerical Methods II

learning_outcomes.text: Numerical analysis of stress and strain state for rod, plate in plane stress state, solid and shell bodies.
Learning the steps in FEM solution of structural problems.
Using finite elements appropriate for different practical problems.

syllabus_topics: Introduction. Steps of FEM analysis. Types of FE.
Truss finite element. Determination of stiffness matrix by direct method. Transformation matrix.
Beam finite element with rigid nodes. Formation of stiffness matrix by direct method.
Plane stress problem in Cartesian coordinates. Triangular finite element with constant stress and strain state. Determination of stiffness matrix based on the principle of virtual work.
Three-dimensional tetrahedral and hexahedral finite elements.
Analysis of stress and strain state of 2D and 3D articulated bar structures.
Analysis of stress and strain state of 2D and 3D beam structures.
Analysis of stress and strain state of parts in plane stress and plane strain state. Axially-symmetric problems.
Analysis of stress and strain state of parts with 3D geometry and loading.
Analysis of stress and strain state for shell-type structures.

assessment_methods.method: Written exam (grid test and theoretical subject)

assessment_rules: The final grade is composed of the exam grade (1/2) and the ongoing activity grade (1/2). A minimum final grade of 5 is required to pass. A minimum average of 5 is required for the two subjects within the written exam. 100% attendance at laboratory sessions is mandatory.
